paragraphs.hr: Prošle subote je Tomislavu bilo trideset godina. Trideset je važan rođendan — nije više dvadesetogodišnjak! Njegova prijatelja Lana i Petar su odlučili organizirati iznenađenje. Tomislav nije znao ništa. Mislio je da će toga dana biti sam kod kuće.
paragraphs.en: Last Saturday Tomislav turned thirty. Thirty is an important birthday — he is no longer a twenty-something! His friends Lana and Petar decided to organise a surprise. Tomislav did not know anything. He thought he would be at home alone that day.

paragraphs.hr: Lana je nazvala sve Tomislavove prijatelje tjedan ranije. Trebalo je kupiti tortu, balone i hranu za zabavu. Petar je kupio veliku čokoladnu tortu u slastičarni. Lana je kupila crvene i zlatne balone i ukrašavala Petrov stan. Sve je izgledalo predivno.
paragraphs.en: Lana called all Tomislav's friends a week earlier. They needed to buy a cake, balloons and food for the party. Petar bought a large chocolate cake at the patisserie. Lana bought red and golden balloons and decorated Petar's flat. Everything looked wonderful.

paragraphs.hr: U subotu navečer, u osam sati, Petar je nazvao Tomislava i rekao mu da dođe — rekao mu je da ima problema s hladnjakom i da mu treba pomoć. Tomislav je mislio: Čudno, ali dobro. Uzeo je jaknu i otišao. Nije imao pojma o iznenađenju.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday evening at eight o'clock Petar called Tomislav and told him to come over — he told him he had a problem with the fridge and needed his help. Tomislav thought: Strange, but okay. He took his jacket and left. He had no idea about the surprise.

paragraphs.hr: Kad je Tomislav otvorio vrata Petrova stana, svi su vikali: Iznenađenje! Tomislav je ostao bez daha. U stanu je bilo petnaest prijatelja — nekoga od njih nije vidio godinama. Bio je toliko sretan da nije mogao govoriti. Lana ga je zagrlila i rekla: Sretan rođendan, prijatelju!
paragraphs.en: When Tomislav opened the door of Petar's flat, everyone shouted: Surprise! Tomislav was left breathless. In the flat there were fifteen friends — some of them he had not seen for years. He was so happy he could not speak. Lana hugged him and said: Happy birthday, friend!

paragraphs.hr: Jeli su, pili i plesali do ponoći. Petar je napravio roštilj — kobasice, ćevapi i piletina. Torta je bila izvrsna — čokoladna i slatka. Tomislav je puhnuo trideset svjećica i svi su pljeskali. Glazba je bila glasna i svi su se odlično zabavili.
paragraphs.en: They ate, drank and danced until midnight. Petar made a barbecue — sausages, ćevapi and chicken. The cake was excellent — chocolatey and sweet. Tomislav blew out thirty candles and everyone clapped. The music was loud and everyone had a great time.

paragraphs.hr: Kad su gosti otišli, Tomislav je sjeo i rekao Lani i Petru: Ovo je bio najljepši rođendan u mom životu. Lana mu je rekla da je zaslužio jer je uvijek dobar prijatelj svima. Tomislav je bio zahvalan za sve — obitelj, prijatelje i zdravlje. Trideset godina nije loše uopće.
paragraphs.en: When the guests had gone, Tomislav sat down and said to Lana and Petar: That was the most beautiful birthday of my life. Lana told him he deserved it because he was always a good friend to everyone. Tomislav was grateful for everything — family, friends and health. Thirty years is not bad at all.
